pattern_explanation: Each of these Ukrainian words looks similar to an English word, such as magazine, actual, baton or correct, because of shared roots or borrowing paths. Over time their meanings drifted apart, so the look-alike English word has a different meaning.
false_friend_warning: Students must not translate these Ukrainian words by their look-alike English words: the transliterated mahazyn means shop rather than magazine, aktualnyi means relevant rather than actual, baton refers to a loaf of bread rather than a baton, and korektnyi means polite rather than correct.
